title:
Make the citation checker resolve a file:line code citation, because the only
thing that stopped UX-08 was a checker that greps docs/ and calls that verified.

The acceptance condition is written to be falsifiable by construction: ship
scripts/verify_audit_citations.py v2 that, for every `file:line` citation it
sees, opens that file and checks the claim is on that line, plus a test that
breaks one citation and asserts the checker reports it. Acceptance: a broken
citation turns the gate red, proven by before/after output, and the test is
the falsification. If UX-08 re-does the a11y audit while this exists, the new
audit cannot be green until this checker passes on its citations
